verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing copy about DLSS, gaming features, and general AI PC branding, with no published TFLOPS/TOPS figures, precision (FP16/FP8/INT8) breakdowns, or sparsity-adjusted throughput specs for the RTX 5070 Ti. Missing for 10: dense/sparse tensor TFLOPS or TOPS numbers per precision (FP8, FP16, INT8, INT4), Tensor Core specifications, and any independent benchmark corroborating throughput claims.
